question: Does the residual separate intention of actuation from reflection of actuation, and from withhold and sensory-only scenes?
purpose: The fly brain is a prior for sense-versus-act structure. The model is not expected to perform a fly function. We mine intention of actuation, reflection of actuation, and related notions.

notions.label: Intention of actuation
notions.description: Commit to an action that has not yet been taken.

notions.label: Reflection of actuation
notions.description: Represent an action that already occurred or is being reviewed.

notions.label: Withhold actuation
notions.description: Choose not to act; wait or watch instead of committing.

notions.label: Sensory motion
notions.description: Track described motion without committing or reviewing an act.
